Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate position at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate position at IIT Guwahati is 05 September 2026. Ensure you apply well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Project Associate position is an M.Sc. in Physics. Candidates with prior experience in thin film deposition will be given preference.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Associate position is 35 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 31,000 to Rs. 37,200, depending on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. How will the selection be made for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate position will be based on an online interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience for the interview round.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the Project Associate recruitment at IIT Guwahati. Both General/OBC and SC/ST candidates are exempt from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the type of job for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Project Associate position at IIT Guwahati is a contractual job. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati) is located in Guwahati, Assam.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Associate position announced in the IIT Guwahati recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Assam apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions. Therefore, candidates from all over India who meet the eligibility criteria are encouraged to apply for the Project Associate position.
